title: A convenient colorimetric assay for Cr(VI) detection based on the nanozyme Cu-4PDA-NH2 with oxidoreductase-like activity
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00175G, Paper
Xixingchi Chen, Jiakang Hu, Xuesong Wang, Qing Han, Chen Chen, Haozhe Xu, Chenyu Liao, Yalin Wang, Yongxin Li
The nanozyme Cu-4PDA-NH2 with oxidoreductase-like activity was developed for the detection of Cr(VI), and a detection kit was created for on-site detection.
